title: Two Women and Baby on Wooden Ramp, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage October 1950 black and white snapshot depicting a family scene outdoors. A younger woman smiles while holding a baby, standing next to an older woman wearing an apron dress and glasses. They are standing on a wooden ramp leading up to a porch of a white clapboard residential building. The photo features iconic deckled scalloped borders characteristic of mid-20th-century photo prints.
